ORY_PROJECT_API_KEY.description: Ory says to keep API keys secure and rotate them when necessary. Bound to a project rather than to a user, so it outlives whoever made it. Both documented prefixes are admitted.

ORY_WORKSPACE_API_KEY.description: Workspace-wide rather than project-wide, so it reaches more than the key above. Same guidance, its own documented prefix.

ORY_SDK_URL.description: Your project's API base. An address. Ory publishes no browser-safe credential; what a browser sees is this URL.
